value.rationale: A natural stochastic regularization gap is the distinction between data consistency and minimum-norm reconstruction. The theorem supplies a precise quantitative transition where better expected residual fit masks increasing solution risk, a full limit covariance for analyzing nullspace leakage, and a simple noise-free example under source assumptions. The result is structurally motivated and not merely a numerical instance or textbook restatement of known qualitative underdetermined failures.
